tidwall_gjson.notes: Single package (gjson.go); deps tidwall/match and tidwall/pretty fetched into the Go module cache. unjs_ufo.setup: if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then V=$(node -p "const v=((require('./package.json').packageManager||'').match(/^pnpm@([0-9.]+)/)||[])[1]; (!v||parseInt(v)<8)?'7.33.7':v"); npx -y pnpm@$V install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir "$SP/pnpm-store"; else npx -y yarn@1.22.22 install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts; fi
unjs_ufo.test: if [ -x node_modules/.bin/vitest ]; then npx --no-install vitest run; else npx --no-install jest; fi
unjs_ufo.notes: node_modules is gitignored. Setup installs per checkout with --frozen-lockfile (lockfiles are not modified): pnpm at the exact version in package.json packageManager via npx, except pnpm<8 (lockfile v5.x), which fails on Node 22 with ERR_INVALID_THIS and is replaced by pnpm 7.33.7; store at $SP/pnpm-store (hardlinked, repeat installs are fast). Commits predating pnpm use yarn@1 with yarn.lock. Tests run vitest (jest on old yarn-era commits); the lint/typecheck steps of `pnpm test` are skipped. The main clone at $SP/fixrepos/unjs_ufo also has a HEAD node_modules (gitignored).

Setup copies the checkout's .ci.gemfile to $SP/gems/jeremyevans_roda/Gemfile so the generated Gemfile.lock lives outside the repo (.ci.gemfile.lock is not gitignored); gems installed under the same dir. `rake spec` runs `ruby -w spec/all.rb` (all core + plugin specs, minitest), ~5s; mail gem prints harmless 'statement not reached' warnings. Worktree stays clean.

hanami_utils.test: RV=3.2.6; grep -Eq 'required_ruby_version = ">= 3\.[3-9]' hanami-utils.gemspec && RV=3.3.6; export PATH="/opt/rbenv/versions/$RV/bin:$PATH" GEM_HOME="$SP/gems/hanami_utils-$RV"; CI=1 bundle _2.7.2_ exec rake spec:unit
hanami_utils.notes: Ruby version is chosen per checkout: Ruby 3.3.6 if the gemspec requires >= 3.3 (2026 commits), otherwise rbenv's Ruby 3.2.6 (/opt/rbenv/versions; older code fails on 3.3: URI not auto-loaded, new NoMethodError message format). GEM_HOME=$SP/gems/hanami_utils-<ruby> holds bundler 2.7.2 (pre-2022 gemspecs require bundler < 3; system bundler is 4.0.18) and the bundle. CI=1 skips byebug/yard. bundle install generates Gemfile.lock in the repo root (gitignored; none committed, so gems resolve to latest compatible versions); tests also write gitignored coverage/ and tmp/. spec:unit = rspec over spec/**/*_spec.rb minus isolation/integration specs, random order, ~2-4s. 2019 commits fail on Ruby 3.2 too (newer rspec no longer loads StringIO; Ruby 3 behaviour changes in Kernel specs). Only 7 candidate commits exist.
